_meta.name: Interior dimensional rules (clearances + standard sizes)
_meta.status: DRAFT — standard published values; VERIFY against Panero & Zelnik 'Human Dimension & Interior Space' + local building code (IBC/IRC, NKBA, ADA/local accessibility) BEFORE any client deliverable.
_meta.purpose: Machine-readable constraints the SketchUp pipeline ENFORCES so generated models are dimensionally BUILDABLE, not just pretty. This is the project's differentiator (attacks the #1 AI failure: spatially-wrong 'soft-contract' output).
_meta.units: Each value gives in (inches) and cm. cm rounded.
_meta.primary_reference: Panero, J. & Zelnik, M. — Human Dimension & Interior Space (anthropometric clearances).

main_walkway_min.note: Primary path; below 36in feels tight / fails accessibility.

minimum_passage_pinch.note: Absolute squeeze between objects; avoid as a main path.

wheelchair_clear_floor.note: ADA clear floor space at a fixture/appliance.

ceiling_min_habitable.note: IRC habitable-room min ~7'6"; 8'0"(96in) is the common standard.

upper_cab_above_counter.note: Backsplash gap, counter to wall-cabinet bottom.

table_edge_to_wall_min.note: Chair pull-out + walk-behind; 44in if a path runs behind.

chair_pullout_clearance.note: To slide a chair out to sit.

counter_landing_beside_sink.note: Min landing on at least one side.

clearance_around_bed.note: At least one side >=30in to make the bed.

comfortable_reach_high.note: Top usable shelf for average adult.

lighting._ref: knowledge/lighting/lumen-method-and-fixture-placement.md §6 (IES illuminance + CCT/CRI + lumen method); v0.1 DRAFT — live rules = dimensional_rules.v0.2.json. Verify vs current IES Recommended Practice before any client deliverable.

general_illuminance_fc._note: Maintained AVERAGE general/circulation illuminance target (footcandles) hit by the AMBIENT layer; task areas get higher local levels from task fixtures (KB §6.2).

cct_recommended_k._note: Correlated colour temperature comfort band per room (KB §6.3); warm for living/sleep, cooler for task rooms.
